title: Haryana Culture: Folk Dances, Saang, Fairs and Crafts: Quiz

questions.question: Which Haryana folk dance is performed only by men of the Ahir community around the Gurgaon region at harvest time?
questions.rationale: Dhamal is the men's dance of the Ahirs. Khoria and Loor are danced by women or girls, and Ghoomar by girls in the west.

questions.question: Khoria, a dance of central Haryana, is performed by:
questions.rationale: Khoria is a women's dance linked with harvest and farm occasions.

questions.question: The name of the dance Phag is linked with which month?
questions.rationale: Phag is danced in Phalgun, close to Holi, and the name comes from the month.

questions.question: Loor is a folk dance performed mainly by:
questions.rationale: Loor is performed by girls in spring and around Holi, with songs in question-and-answer form.

questions.question: Which is the one-sided drum that gives its name to a Haryana spring harvest dance?
questions.rationale: The Daph dance is accompanied by the daph drum. Manjira is a pair of hand cymbals used in Chaupaiya.

questions.question: Who is honoured as Suryakavi and is the best-known name in Haryanvi saang and raagni?
questions.rationale: Pandit Lakhmi Chand (1903-1945) of Jaanti Kalan, Sonipat, is the leading figure of saang and raagni.

questions.question: Saang is best described as:
questions.rationale: Saang is open-air folk theatre mixing songs, dialogue and humour.

questions.question: Which dialect is spoken in the western parts of Haryana near Rajasthan?
questions.rationale: Bagri is the western dialect. Ahirwati and Mewati belong to the south, and Braj to the southeast.

questions.question: Which statement about the Surajkund International Crafts Mela is correct?
options: It is held at Pinjore in June
It is held in Kurukshetra in December
It began in 1987 and is held at Surajkund, Faridabad, in February
questions.rationale: Surajkund Mela started in 1987 and is held in the first fortnight of February. The theme state idea began in 1989.

questions.question: Which state was the first Theme State at the Surajkund Mela when the concept began in 1989?
questions.rationale: Rajasthan was the first theme state.

questions.question: The International Gita Mahotsav is held at which place?
questions.rationale: It is held at Kurukshetra, around Brahma Sarovar, near Gita Jayanti.

questions.question: The Pinjore Heritage Festival takes place at which venue?
questions.rationale: It is held in December at Yadavindra Gardens, Pinjore, in Panchkula district.

questions.question: Which is NOT correctly matched?
options: Ghoomar - men's dance of the Ahirs
questions.rationale: Ghoomar is danced by girls in western Haryana; Dhamal is the Ahir men's dance.

questions.question: Gugga Navami is observed on the ninth day of the dark half of which month?
questions.rationale: Goga Navami falls on Krishna Paksha Navami of Bhadrapada.

questions.question: A Sarv Khap is:
options: A court of the High Court
An assembly of several khap panchayats
questions.rationale: A khap panchayat is an assembly of elders of a clan; a Sarv Khap brings several of them together.
